author: Kairos I
title: Batch Ridge Solve (Multi-seed)
abstract: Runs ridge solve over multiple seeds, aggregates metrics, writes lineage/shared artifacts, and prints summary.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/kairos')

import experiments.ridge_batch as rb

def main():
    seeds = [111, 222, 333, 444, 555]
    lp, sp, rid, agg = rb.run_batch(seeds=seeds, n=300, lam=1e-3, tag="template_batch")
    print("BATCH_OK")
    print("lineage_file:", lp)
    print("shared_file:", sp)
    print("run_id:", rid)
    print("runs:", agg["runs"])
    print("resid_mean:", agg["resid_mean"])
    print("elapsed_mean:", agg["elapsed_mean"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
